source: class Coin { public int Value = 7; }
class Holder<T> { public List<T> Values = []; }
class Deep { public List<List<List<int>>> Values = []; }
class TupleSets { public List<Set<(Reference<Coin>, int)>> Values = []; }
class SetMap { public Dictionary<string, Set<int>> Values = {}; }
class Sets<T> { public List<Set<T>> Values = []; }
class Lists { public List<List<int>> Values = []; }
class Maps { public List<Dictionary<string, int>> Values = []; }
class Probe {
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Holder<List<string>> SavedStrings = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Holder<Dictionary<string, string>> SavedMaps = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Coin IdSource = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Sets<int> B = new();
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Sets<int> C = new();
public static int OwnLocalSet() { Sets<int> b = new(); Sets<int> c = new(); List<int> e = []; b.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); c.Values.Add(b.Values[0]); return c.Values.Count; }
public static int OwnStoredSet() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); C.Values.Add(B.Values[0]); return C.Values.Count; }
public static int OwnList() { Lists b = new(); Lists c = new(); b.Values.Add([3]); c.Values.Add(b.Values[0]); return c.Values.Count; }
public static int OwnDictionary() { Maps b = new(); Maps c = new(); b.Values.Add({ "k": 3 }); c.Values.Add(b.Values[0]); return c.Values.Count; }
public static int InsertOwnedSet() { List<int> e = []; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); C.Values.Insert(0, B.Values[0]); return C.Values.Count; }
public static int RejectAtomic() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); try { C.Values.Add(B.Values[0]); } catch (string message) {} return B.Values.Count * 10 + C.Values.Count; }
public static int RemoveThenAttach() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); var s = B.Values[0]; B.Values.Remove(s); C.Values.Add(s); return C.Values[0].Count; }
public static int ClearThenAttach() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); var s = B.Values[0]; B.Values.Clear(); C.Values.Add(s); return C.Values[0].Count; }
public static int FreshSets() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); C.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); return B.Values[0].Count + C.Values[0].Count; }
public static int OwnAliasSet() { List<int> e = [3]; var s = e.ToSet(); B.Values.Add(s); C.Values.Add(s); return C.Values.Count; }
public static int DuplicateSet() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); B.Values.Add(B.Values[0]); return B.Values.Count; }
public static int OwnDictionaryEntry() { List<int> e = [3]; SetMap b = new(); SetMap c = new(); b.Values.Add("k", e.ToSet()); c.Values.Add("k", b.Values["k"]); return c.Values.Count; }

public static int OwnTupleSet() { List<(Reference<Coin>, int)> e = [(new Coin(), 1)]; TupleSets b = new(); TupleSets c = new(); b.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); c.Values.Add(b.Values[0]); return c.Values.Count; }
public static int SetAliasStaysLive() { List<int> e = [3]; var s = e.ToSet(); B.Values.Add(s); B.Values[0].Add(4); return s.Count; }

public static int ReadInsertedValues() { Lists l = new(); l.Values.Add([3]); Maps m = new(); m.Values.Add({ "k": 4 }); List<int> e = [5]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); return l.Values[0][0] + m.Values[0]["k"] + (B.Values[0].Contains(5) ? 5 : 0); }

public static int RejectedInsertAtomic() { List<int> e = [3]; B.Values.Add(e.ToSet()); C.Values.Add([4].ToSet()); try { C.Values.Insert(0, B.Values[0]); } catch (string message) {} return B.Values.Count * 10 + C.Values.Count; }
public static int NestedOwned() { Holder<List<List<int>>> b = new(); b.Values.Add([]); b.Values[0].Add([3]); Holder<List<int>> c = new(); c.Values.Add(b.Values[0][0]); return 1; }
public static int NonGenericNestedOwned() { Deep b = new(); b.Values.Add([]); b.Values[0].Add([3]); Holder<List<int>> c = new(); c.Values.Add(b.Values[0][0]); return 1; }
public static int NestedAliasesStayLive() { Holder<List<List<int>>> b = new(); List<int> leaf = [3]; List<List<int>> nest = [leaf]; b.Values.Add(nest); leaf.Add(4); return b.Values[0][0].Count; }
public static int SaveScalarIds() { SavedStrings.Values.Add([IdSource.Id]); SavedMaps.Values.Add({"k": IdSource.Id}); return 1; }
public static int ReadScalarIds() { return (SavedStrings.Values[0][0] == IdSource.Id ? 1 : 0) + (SavedMaps.Values[0]["k"] == IdSource.Id ? 1 : 0); }
public static int ListReferences() { Holder<List<Reference<Coin>>> b = new(); b.Values.Add([IdSource]); return b.Values[0][0].Value; }
public static int DictionaryReferences() { Holder<Dictionary<string, Reference<Coin>>> b = new(); b.Values.Add({"k": IdSource}); return b.Values[0]["k"].Value; }
public static int TupleReferences() { Holder<List<(Reference<Coin>, int)>> b = new(); b.Values.Add([(IdSource, 1)]); return b.Values[0][0].Item1.Value + b.Values[0][0].Item2; }
public static int ExplicitListReferences() { var b = new Holder<List<Reference<Coin>>>(); b.Values.Add([IdSource]); return b.Values[0][0].Value; }
public static int RefuseOwnedClass() { Holder<List<Coin>> b = new(); b.Values.Add([IdSource]); return 1; }

public static int FailedEncodingCleanup() { Holder<Coin> owner = new(); Coin used = new(); owner.Values.Add(used); Coin fresh = new(); Holder<List<Coin>> dest = new(); List<Coin> batch = [fresh, used]; try { dest.Values.Add(batch); } catch(string message) {} if (owner.Values.Count != 1 || dest.Values.Count != 0 || batch.Count != 2 || batch[0].Value != 7 || batch[1].Value != 7) return -1; owner.Values.Remove(used); dest.Values.Add(batch); return dest.Values[0].Count; }
